en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Daqqan, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Bashir the masseur, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who oils (massages) a Believer, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Writes for him with every hair, a radiance on the Day of Judgement’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Daqqaq from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah from Bashir al-Dahhan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one applies oil on a believing person, Allah writes for every hair a light on the Day of Judgment.’”
